description: Tinny has asked you to prepare for her an intoxicating brew, as the Cauldron she would typically use has fallen victim to some kind of magical sickness. You recall seeing a spare one in your own home. Better head back there and see if you can follow the recipe the old hag wrote down  in your journal…
name: An Intoxicating Brew Part 2
completed: Return to Tinny with her concoction to continue your training.
